doc: Several entry/exit/transition actions, four levels of nesting and three regions. Entry in document order with each initializer's actions when its region is reached; exit in exact reverse.

steps.doc: Region initializers run after their owner's entry and after the regions above, before the states in the region.
Explicit entry of L4: the regions on its path are not entered by default, so i1, i11 and i1111 do not run.
L4 and N2 lie in different regions of Top, so the domain is the root region: Top is left and re-entered.
